excerpts.author: marekm3498
excerpts.content:
Quick question related to https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7691 and https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7840:

We introduced chainspec parameters for max and target, but it seems we also modified BLOB_BASE_FEE_UPDATE_FRACTION for Pectra. My question is:
Should we add update_fraction to the chainspec as well? It seems like a logical step, but it is not specified in 7840. Is there any reason why it wasn’t included?

cc: <@822845173016166410> <@696356193953775686> 😉

excerpts.author: parithosh
excerpts.content:
Lighthouse joins the party 😄

I've updated the pinned message to include them.
